Lawrence [[226]] ..."I often look at the injustices of this world... and I see those who crush those at the bottom... can a person truly take their crimes to the grave? There must be a force afterward... beyond the Physical... otherwise, where does Justice originate from, if not for the dead?"

"I often as myself... of all the storm I have to bear on my own... what would happen if I were to release my torrenting force of wrath? But who am I to judge by my own hand? If I am willing to enatct justice by taking the life of another being, I am just as evil as the evil-doer whom I fight tool-and-nail against... "

"We are just as terrible, whether we face it or not... our only difference is the difference... which makes all the difference. Do you want to make a difference in the world? Start by changing the way you respond to your own inner storm."
